name: Proposify
description: Proposify is a proposal, quote, contract, and electronic-signature platform for organizing sales documents from creation through close. Revenue teams use it to manage reusable content, control approvals, deliver buyer-facing proposals, track engagement, and capture legally binding signatures.
agentUseSummary: Connect the customer's sole Proposify Connect confidential client with exactly read_documents authority, then let agents inspect privacy-redacted lifecycle metadata for one explicit V3 document UUID. Relay exchanges short-lived client-credentials tokens server-side and blocks people, content, clients, signatures, links, writes, events, administration, broader scopes, and raw access.

credentialRequirements.name: PROPOSIFY_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Proposify Connect client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the sole customer-owned API connection in Proposify Connect settings.

credentialRequirements.name: PROPOSIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Proposify Connect client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the generated confidential client secret and store it only in Relay's encrypted boundary.

capabilities.label: Inspect document metadata
capabilities.description: Read one explicit V3 document's redacted lifecycle metadata with exactly read_documents authority.

allowed.label: Inspect document metadata
allowed.description: Inspect privacy-redacted lifecycle metadata for one explicit Proposify V3 document UUID.

blocked.label: Access private proposal content
blocked.description: Document bodies, sections, fees, signatures, recipients, contacts, companies, users, client data, PDFs, links, and custom fields are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or send documents
blocked.description: Creation, section changes, updates, sending, signing, approval, won/lost transitions, deletion, and downloads are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broader OAuth authority
blocked.description: Events, legacy documents, templates, companies, users, admin/client management, credential rotation, and scopes beyond read_documents are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk access
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, retries, batches, exports, and provider-response pass-through are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only document lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: One fixed privacy-redacted V3 document metadata lookup runs automatically with exactly read_documents authority.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Exact scope, customer-owned client boundary, fixed token and document routes, strict projection, and read-only behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway exchanges the customer-owned confidential client for short-lived exact-scope tokens and mounts one fixed redacted V3 document lookup.

providerSetup.blocker: Proposify Connect API access requires the Business Plan, an account administrator, and the account's sole API connection with a confidential client ID and secret. No eligible account, credentials, signed-in session, Railway change, or live acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Proposify administrator confirms the Business Plan, creates or updates the sole Connect API client, limits it to read_documents, stores the client ID and secret through Relay's encrypted connection flow, then separately validates token exchange, redacted V3 document lookup, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Proposify documents the fixed https://connect.proposify.com origin, authorization-code, refresh-token, and client-credentials token grants, Bearer tokens, and GET /v3/document/{uuid}; Relay selects only the client-credentials read path.
Proposify's official integration tutorial identifies read_documents as the scope for reading document details and separately identifies prismatic for event access; Relay requests only read_documents.
Proposify documents admin creation of one API connection per account, generated client ID and secret, configurable redirect URIs, and credential rotation with a one-hour grace period.
Proposify states that Connect API access is available on its Business Plan.
